decisions.reason: Eliminating Big Block prizes does not change the referral milestones or conditions used to award badges.
The badge set, icon rules, and badge presentation remain valid independently of Big Block removal.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block messaging and updates the primary-mint allocation without leaving an explicit obsolete Big Block attribute.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows the counters and scope to Small Block tickets, removes obsolete Big Block lifecycle keys, and retains the removal as an operational fact.
Random, ticket-weighted, on-chain winner selection remains applicable to the surviving Small Block mechanism; the source does not change the selection method or fairness rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the dual-ticket referral award with one Small Block ticket while preserving the $5 commission.
Big Block removal does not alter the NFT mint number's role, permanence, or display locations as a referral code.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows the no-code reward to a Small Block prize ticket; recipient eligibility and the $5 commission remain unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5 primary-mint allocation and identifies the Small Block prize pool as the sole active pool.
The source changes primary-mint allocation and removes Big Blocks but does not change the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
Automatic prize transfer and winner notifications remain valid for the surviving Small Block prizes; the source does not change the payout workflow.
The source preserves the recurring $500 Small Block mechanism and does not change its winner count, prize amount, eligibility, or 100-sale draw trigger.
